definitions.explanation: becoming slower, less active, or less vigorous, typically used for economic indicators or rates of change

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}が{鈍化|どんか}している。
{景気|けいき}の{鈍化|どんか}が{懸念|けねん}される。
examples.english: There are concerns about economic slowdown.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}の{伸|の}びが{鈍化|どんか}してきた。
examples.english: Sales growth has started to decelerate.

examples.japanese: インフレの{鈍化|どんか}により{金利|きんり}が{下|さ}がる{可能性|かのうせい}がある。
examples.english: Interest rates may fall due to the slowdown in inflation.

notes:
{鈍化|どんか} refers to the process of becoming slower or less vigorous, primarily used in economic and business contexts.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {鈍|どん} (dull, blunt, slow)
- {化|か} (-ification, becoming)

USAGE:
- {鈍化|どんか}する (to slow down, to decelerate - suru verb)
- 〜の{鈍化|どんか} (slowdown of ~)

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- {経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}の{鈍化|どんか} (economic growth slowdown)
- {景気|けいき}の{鈍化|どんか} (economic slowdown)
- {消費|しょうひ}の{鈍化|どんか} (consumption slowdown)
- {需要|じゅよう}の{鈍化|どんか} (demand deceleration)
- インフレの{鈍化|どんか} (inflation slowdown)

REGISTER:
- Formal/technical
- Common in economic news, business reports, and financial analysis

CONTRAST:
- {加速|かそく} (acceleration) - opposite
- {停滞|ていたい} (stagnation) - more severe than {鈍化|どんか}

RELATED TERMS:
- {減速|げんそく} (deceleration, slowdown)
- {停滞|ていたい} (stagnation)
- {低迷|ていめい} (sluggishness, slump)
- {下降|かこう} (decline, downturn)
